patch.origin: Original wrapper matches frozen npm jassub 1.8.8 after format normalization. This is an explicit local patch, not a claim of unchanged upstream bytes.
changes: constructor rollback and cancellation of late initialization
idempotent destruction and ownership of actual canvas parent
per-video generations and cancellation for render/color-space callbacks
query settlement and cleanup before callbacks, including destroy cancellation
per-video polyfill IDs/maps and zero-quality-counter media-time fallback capped at 30 Hz per continuous chain
patch.unchanged: Worker JS, WASM, fonts, resource URLs, root declarations and actual public instance identity remain unchanged. Original provenance manifests are not rewritten.

controlled.firstCandidateFailureResolution: The historical mixed return/resize test inspected queued resize after terminating the Worker. It now checks delivery before destroy without weakening dimensions or synchronous-return assertions. A separate exact old-red/candidate-green regression verifies cancellation after readiness. Source/main/legacy now each pass 68.
controlled.scope: Actual vendor under controlled platform, including complete real WASM query tests; historical defect confirmations are not candidate browser acceptance.

browser.scope: Windows Playwright real Worker/WASM/font/video; offscreenRender=false. Default onDemandRender, native RVFC where available, all-zero quality polyfill only where needed. Not Chrome extension interaction, physical Safari/mobile, default offscreen or sustained GPU/memory verification.
